title: Back-translation diff report template + independent back-translator workflow (ISO-style Tier-C flow)
context: PLAN v0.2 makes back-translator independence explicit and adds a committed back-translation diff report as a required artifact for every Tier-C phrase. The ISO-style flow is: independent forward translator → independent reviewer → independent back-translator (NOT the forward translator) → recorded reconciliation. A systematic error masked when the same person drafts and back-checks is the risk being mitigated. The diff report surfaces negation inversions, number/unit drift, and false friends for human adjudication. Generating the diff report is described as where the agent adds the most safety value (flagging, not certifying). The back-translator-independence declaration and the diff report are both committed to review.yaml. Existing tasks (review-001, translate-001) mention back-translation but do not capture this new artifact, independence requirement, or reconciliation record.
objective: Author the back-translation diff report template and document the independent back-translator workflow (ISO-style Tier-C flow) so reviewers can execute and record the full flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Template captures: forward-translator identity, reviewer identity, back-translator identity, and a back-translator-independence declaration (back-translator ≠ forward translator; no shared mental model)

Diff report format surfaces, per Tier-C phrase: the forward translation, the back-translation, and flagged divergences categorized as negation inversion / number-unit drift / false friend / register shift / other
Documents that the diff report flags divergences for human adjudication — it never self-certifies or auto-passes; every flagged divergence has a recorded human reconciliation outcome
Specifies how the completed diff report is committed into review.yaml (field names, structure) alongside the back-translator-independence declaration
States hard gate: no Tier-C sign-off may be recorded while any back-translation diff flag is unresolved
Reviewer checklist (review-001) and handoff template (review-002) are documented as needing to reference this template
